code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        stack.append((ny, nx))
            minr = min(y for y, x in cells)
            maxr = max(y for y, x in cells)
            minc = min(x for y, x in cells)
            maxc = max(x for y, x in cells)
            occupied = set(cells)
            perimeter = {(y, x) for y in range(minr, maxr + 1) for x in range(minc, maxc + 1)
                         if y in (minr, maxr) or x in (minc, maxc)}
            is_frame = perimeter <= occupied
            objects.append({'color': color, 'cells': cells, 'frame': is_frame,
                            'minr': minr, 'maxr': maxr})

    placed = []
    for direction in (-1, 1):
        group = [o for o in objects if o['frame'] == (direction == -1)]
        group.sort(key=lambda o: o['minr'] if direction == -1 else -o['maxr'])
        for obj in group:
            cells = obj['cells']
            while True:
                moved = [(r + direction, c) for r, c in cells]
                if any(not (0 <= r < h) for r, c in moved):
                    break
                if any((r, c) in other for r, c in moved for other in placed):
                    break
                cells = moved
            obj['placed'] = cells
            placed.append(set(cells))

    out = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for obj in objects:
        for r, c in obj['placed']:
            out[r][c] = obj['color']
    return out
'''
